# vCard & Event QR Code Generator

> A free, open-source browser tool for creating vCard contact QR codes and iCalendar event QR codes.

## Primary URL

- https://mralexgarrido.github.io/vCard-Generator/

## Capabilities

- Creates vCard 3.0 contact data
- Creates iCalendar 2.0 timed and all-day event data
- Downloads QR codes as PNG and SVG
- Downloads source data as VCF and ICS
- Converts local timed events to UTC
- Validates required fields, URLs, time zones, event duration, and QR payload size

## Privacy

All entries are processed in browser memory. The application has no account system, analytics, database, cookies, persistent browser storage, or server-side processing.

## Source and documentation

- Repository: https://github.com/mralexgarrido/vCard-Generator
- License: MIT

QR behavior varies by device and scanner application. Test a final QR code on intended devices before large-scale printing or distribution.
